message.reasoning:
We need to decide whether to buy St. Charles Place (price $140) or start auction. Player p1 has cash 980, holdings: Mediterranean and Baltic (brown). No pink properties yet. Group pink has 3 spaces: St. Charles Place, States Avenue, Virginia Avenue. Buying gives us 1/3 of group, not yet monopoly. Price is cheap relative to cash. Buying adds to portfolio, increases rent potential. Also prevents others from getting monopoly. Likely good to buy.

Consider opponents: Beta at Kentucky Avenue (orange). Gamma has Reading Railroad and Electric Company. Delta at Short Line (railroad). No one has pink. So buying is safe.

We have cash 980, after purchase 840 left, still plenty.

Thus choose buy_property.

Public message: maybe say "I buy it." Could also be friendly. Keep concise.

Private thought: reasoning.

Make tool call buy_property with arguments.

function.name: buy_property
function.arguments: {"private_thought": "St. Charles Place is cheap and gives me a foothold in the pink group. I have ample cash (980) and buying leaves me with 840, still strong.
